Style guide

Every variable, class and component this site is built from, drawn by the site’s own styles. Start here before you build or change anything.

How to use this page
Four habits that keep the site consistent.
01
Find it
Use the list of sections. Every variable, class and component this site uses is on this page, grouped by kind.
02
Read a row
On the left: the name as the Designer shows it, the CSS class, and what it is bound to. On the right: the real thing, drawn by the site’s own styles.
03
Reuse before you add
Building something new? Look here first, and use the variable or class that already exists.
04
Add it here
A new class or component gets its row here in the same piece of work, so nothing is lost when unused styles are cleaned up.

The fill layer of C | Button. Hover and pressed are states on the class; colours follow the section's theme.

08

Forms

Fields, labels and messages as they look inside a form.

Form
.form · .form-field · .label · .form-input · .is-textarea
Form Block with a text field, a select, a textarea and a submit button. Form Input is the one class for all three (it replaces Webflow's input defaults); Is Textarea makes it tall. Focus states: border on focus, ring on keyboard focus.
09

Components

Reusable blocks. In Webflow each one is a component: insert an instance, never copy the markup.

Icon
.icon-color › .icon › .icon-glyph
One component: Phosphor icon with a colour and a size. Prop Icon: ph ph-name, from phosphoricons.com. Color: Inherit, Primary, Secondary, Accent, Success, Warning, Error. Size (the inner Icon Size): 12px to 64px, named at 16px text and set in em, so it scales with the font size around it.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
C | Button
.button › .button-color › .button-size › .button-content
The link button. Props: Label, Link, Icon, Icon Before, Icon After. Color: Primary, Secondary. Size: Default, Small.
Button
 
 
Back
C | Icon Button
.button › .icon-button-box
Icon-only button element. Props: Icon, Accessible Name (required: what the button does), Hook (the data attribute a script listens for). Variants: Primary, Secondary.
C | Video
.video
Plays a file hosted through the media page. Props: MP4, WebM with its switch Has WebM (an optional second source, offered first), Poster, and one text prop per attribute (autoplay, muted, loop, playsinline): clear a prop to remove the attribute.
Section Head
.section-head
Chip, heading and text at the top of a section. Props: Chip, Show Chip, Heading, Text.
Chip

Section heading

One or two lines that say what this section is about.
